meta.title: Judge-to-OSF trace: which judges reach OSF in one step
meta.method: Merged every published data file and computed the shortest path from each judge node to OSF. Checked the repo history for removed judge-OSF edges: the only removals were 'none found' entries taken off the public site on 31 Oct 2026, no fact edge was lost. Searched Batory annual reports (2005-07, 2010-11, 2013, 2021-22, 2025, readable parts), Batory's Legal Experts Team biographies, an HFHR Watch Docs discussion pack and press for Berek, Dziurda, Szostek, Bentkowska and Korwin-Piotrowska.
meta.summary: One step to OSF on fact edges: Markiewicz, Taborowski, Patyra (indirect ties via Batory), now also Korwin-Piotrowska (indirect, via Themis's Batory grants). Dziurda, Szostek, Berek: 3 steps; Bentkowska: 2 steps (via Markiewicz). No sourced personal or organisational OSF/Batory tie found for those four.

edges.relation: INDIRECT: Themis, which she now presides, got about PLN 155,000 in 2014-16 from a programme run by OSF-founded and OSF-funded Batory; that money was EEA/Norway Grants, not OSF's own. No payment to her personally

leads.lead: Bentkowska reaches OSF in one step
leads.result: Shortest fact chain is 2 steps: Bentkowska > Markiewicz (brought him into the TK judges' section, 22 Oct 2026) > OSF (indirect). Also Bentkowska > Obywatele RP (pro bono defender 2016-23) > Batory (PLN 30,000 to Fundacja Wolni Obywatele RP, 2020) > OSF. Her name is absent from the Batory reports and expert lists read.
leads.label: speculation
